tools.name: presign_quick_check
tools.description: Free: the green/orange/red verdict only, for a transaction, token approval or EIP-712 signature your agent is about to sign. Limited to 10 calls per hour. For the reason codes and details use presign_check ($0.01); for a plain-language explanation presign_check_explain ($0.03).

tools.name: token_quick_verdict
tools.description: Free: the green/orange/red verdict and grade only, for a Solana or EVM token your agent is about to buy, hold or accept. Limited to 10 free calls per hour (shared with presign_quick_check). For the reasons, one-line summary and market data use token_verdict ($0.01).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: presign_check, presign_check_explain · Private data: presign_quick_check, token_quick_verdict, presign_check, token_verdict, wallet_approvals · Public sink: presign_check, presign_check_explain, token_verdict · Destructive: feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: presign_check, presign_check_explain · Private data: presign_quick_check, token_quick_verdict, presign_check, token_verdict, wallet_approvals · Public sink: presign_check, presign_check_explain, token_verdict · Destructive: feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
